capstones.name: Warlord's Bravery
capstones.effect: For 3 minutes, +30% melee damage, +20% mitigation. Immune to fear and mez.
capstones.description: The bravery of the ancient warlords of Kunark.

capstones.name: Repel the Wicked
capstones.effect: Knock back all undead within 30 feet. Deal 2000 + (level × 15) holy damage to undead. Stun undead 6 seconds.
capstones.description: The wicked — living or dead — are repelled by righteous might.

capstones.name: Soul Abrasion
capstones.effect: Lifetap strike: 2500 + (level × 15) damage, heal for 125% of damage dealt. Applies -20 to target's resists for 1 minute.
capstones.description: The shadowknight abrades the victim's very soul.

capstones.name: Crane Stance
capstones.effect: For 2 minutes, +35% damage, +15% dodge, attacks cannot be parried.
capstones.description: The crane stance — balance, precision, and unstoppable strikes.

capstones.name: Assassin Discipline
capstones.effect: For 90 seconds, assassination chance +20%, backstab damage +40%.
capstones.description: The rogue becomes death itself — the perfect assassin.

capstones.name: Blinding Fury
capstones.effect: Burst: 5 instant axe strikes at +60% damage each. Blinds target (-30 accuracy) for 30 seconds.
capstones.description: Fury so blinding the enemy cannot see the axes coming.

capstones.name: Frost Arrows
capstones.effect: For 5 minutes, bow attacks deal +40% damage as cold. 20% chance to proc a 500-point cold strike and snare.
capstones.description: The ranger's arrows carry the chill of ancient Kunark.

capstones.name: Chameleon Strike
capstones.effect: Strike for 2000 + (level × 12) damage. Reduce hate by 80%. Warder gains +50% damage for 30 seconds.
capstones.description: Strike unseen, vanish, let the warder finish.

capstones.name: Dance of Blades
capstones.effect: Aura (2 min): enemies within 20 feet take -20% weapon speed, -15 to resists. Allies gain +10% attack speed.
capstones.description: Blades dance to the bard's tune — allies quicken, enemies falter.

capstones.name: Divine Guardian
capstones.effect: Target buff (5 min): -30% damage taken. When the target would die, heal to 75% instead (one-time).
capstones.description: A divine guardian watches over the chosen.

capstones.name: Group Spirit of the Black Wolf
capstones.effect: Group buff (10 min): +40% run speed, +25% attack, +15% damage.
capstones.description: The black wolf's spirit runs with the pack.

capstones.name: Languid Bite
capstones.effect: Target: 60% slow + stacking poison DoT (500/tick, stacks 3x) for 2 minutes.
capstones.description: The serpent's languid bite — slow death.

capstones.name: Haze
capstones.effect: Debuff all enemies within 30 feet: -40 accuracy, -25% damage for 2 minutes.
capstones.description: A haze settles over the enemy's minds.

capstones.name: Heart of Flames
capstones.effect: Aura (3 min): allies within 30 feet gain +25% fire damage, +15 fire resist. Enemies take 200 fire/tick.
capstones.description: The magician's heart burns with elemental fire.

capstones.name: Death's Malaise
capstones.effect: Debuff target (3 min): -30 to all resists, takes +25% DoT damage, -20% healing received.
capstones.description: Death's malaise settles on the victim — nothing can save them now.

capstones.name: Fury of Ro
capstones.effect: For 90 seconds, fire spells +60% damage, +20% crit chance on fire.
capstones.description: The Tyrant of Fire's fury channels through the wizard.
